title: GRU 门控公式数值演算
code:
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(2)
def sigmoid(x): return 1.0/(1.0+np.exp(-x))
H = 4
W = {k: np.random.randn(H, 2*H)*0.5 for k in ['z','r','n']}
b = {k: np.zeros(H) for k in ['z','r','n']}
h_prev = np.random.randn(H)*0.1
x = np.random.randn(H)
cat = np.concatenate([h_prev, x])
z = sigmoid(W['z'] @ cat + b['z'])
r = sigmoid(W['r'] @ cat + b['r'])
n = np.tanh(W['n'] @ np.concatenate([r*h_prev, x]) + b['n'])
h = (1 - z) * h_prev + z * n
print("隐藏维度 H =", H)
print("更新门 z (sigmoid):", np.round(z,3))
print("重置门 r (sigmoid):", np.round(r,3))
print("候选隐态 n (tanh):", np.round(n,3))
print("新隐态 h = (1-z)*h_prev + z*n:", np.round(h,3))
print("z 接近 1 -> 保留旧隐态; z 接近 0 -> 用候选 n")
print("验证: 更新门区间正确 ->", bool(z.max()<1 and z.min()>0))
